name: AXM AI Team
summary: One collaboration and agent control room for multi-model work, tasks, reusable specialist masks, creative exploration, agent identity, tools, skills, prompt and model evaluation, local learning evidence, connectors and safety.
notes: AI Team v1.5 adds a recommendation-only Specialist Router. It ranks up to three methods and previews capability bridges, but cannot check out a mask, attach a skill or start an AI. Inspect & prepare only fills the separate checkout form; manual confirmation remains the default and structural requirement.
